summary: Full E2E of sprint-1 fix-pack 2 & 3 for Chez Dina. Backend: 10/10 pytest green (roles-permissions GET+PATCH, approval-requests, expense-requests, stock/adjustment-requests, audit-logs, cash-sessions, manager-balance, invoices/from-order POST, access-control sales→403 on audit). Frontend verified end-to-end: (1) /console/roles — 4-level matrix (Aucun/Lecture/Modif./Complet) rendered with 76 selects, SENSIBLE tag + red border on Stock & inventaire and Dépenses when level=full, Admin column locked on Complet, 'Nouveau rôle' and 'Enregistrer' buttons present, per-section bulk 'Gérante · bulk / Vendeuse · bulk / Stock · bulk / Livreur · bulk' selects in each section header. (2) /console/approbations — 3 KPI cards (En attente=3, Approuvées=0, Refusées=0), type chips (Remise/Remboursement/Ajustement/Prix/Dépense/Versement caisse), 3 pending items with 3 Approuver + 3 Refuser buttons + commentaire optional input. (3) /console/audit — filters (Utilisateur / Action / Période 7j default / recherche libre), Export Excel button, 12 <details> diff blocks (before/after), access control confirmed: manager login on /console/audit shows 'Accès réservé'. (4) /console/sessions-caisse — 4 KPIs (Sessions=2, À valider=0, Encaissements cumulés=0 FCFA, Écarts cumulés=25000 FCFA), Historique table with Versé + Écart Owner columns, 'Ouvrir caisse' button. (5) POS guard verified with manager login: overlay 'Ouvrez votre session de caisse pour commencer' + 'Ouvrir la session' button visible on /console/pos. (6) /console/commandes — ALL 9 KPI testids present (orders-kpi-nouvelles/prep/pretes/livraison/livrees/annulees/reportees/rate/ca), clicking orders-kpi-livrees filters to 338 livrées, Facture column renders invoice-view/pdf/wa testids on every row. (7) Regression: Dashboard, Statistiques, Finances, Livraisons, Produits, Stock, Clients, Manuel, Settings all load without TypeError.

issues: Tour auto-opens on every page visit even when localStorage dina_tour_* keys are set after mount — pre-existing (non-blocking).
Legacy warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' still logged from a Select somewhere under ConsoleLayout (line 185); harmless but pollutes console.

critical_code_review_comments: Roles bulk UX uses per-section selects labelled '<role> · bulk' instead of a visible button 'Appliquer à toute la section' — functionally equivalent but spec wording differs; consider aligning label if marketing/UX text is contractual.
Hydration warning (<span> in <option>) persists across iterations — track down the Select rendering a span inside <option> (likely a shadcn Select used as <select>); replace with text-only children.
Invoice buttons on Orders table: 200+ buttons per view may slow DOM; consider lazy-rendering per visible rows or virtualization at >500 orders (current list = 583).
